description: Global Energy Monitor’s Global Gas Finance Tracker links pre-operational gas-fired power and LNG projects to publicly identified project-specific finance. Coverage includes Australia, Canada, Latin America, the Caribbean and selected South, East and Southeast Asian countries. The July 2026 release records project-level debt and equity, financial investment decisions and development status, with capacity summaries in gigawatts and million tonnes of LNG per year. Public map and dashboard routes accompany a downloadable database; its export format was not confirmed. Access is free under GEM’s default CC BY 4.0 policy unless otherwise stated. A limitation is that the tracker uses a broader definition of project finance than a dedicated special-purpose-vehicle structure, while excluding finance without an explicit public project linkage. Research cut-off dates differ across releases, so some operating or newly announced projects can be misaligned with the listed status. Simulation uses include assessing financing constraints on prospective gas infrastructure. It complements data-gem-global-gas-infrastructure-tracker and data-gem-global-oil-and-gas-plant-tracker. No same-resource catalogue or first-review draft was found, and no financial-data files were downloaded.
